deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Keuangan Nomor 37 Tahun 2025 tentang Penunjukan Pemungut, Tata Cara Pemungutan, Penyetoran, dan Pelaporan Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 22 atas Penjualan Barang Dagangan Melalui Sistem Elektronik
deltas.title_en: Minister of Finance Regulation No. 37 of 2025 — PPh Article 22 on e-commerce marketplace sales: IMPLEMENTATION DATE CORRECTION — actual collection starts August 1, 2026
deltas.impact_note: Actual PPh 22 (0.5%) collection by designated marketplaces starts Aug 1, 2026 (not July 1 as previously reported); first-batch designation covers 4 platforms only: Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada, Blibli — Bukalapak and others follow in subsequent batches.
deltas.summary: DDTC 2026-07-03: PMK 37/2025 previously reported effective July 1, 2026 was the regulation entry-into-force date, not the actual collection start. DJP designated 4 marketplaces in first batch (Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada, Blibli); actual PPh 22 0.5% withholding on merchant transactions begins August 1, 2026. Finance Minister confirmed phased approach: all platforms eventually designated in stages. Merchants under Rp 500 juta/year threshold still exempt with surat pernyataan.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Pemungutan pajak sebesar 0,5% oleh penyedia marketplace tersebut akan berlaku efektif mulai 1 Agustus 2026. Dia menyebut penunjukan penyedia marketplace sebagai pemungut pajak berdasarkan PMK 37/2025 bukanlah pengenaan pajak jenis baru. Pada akhirnya nanti semuanya [ditunjuk] secara bertahap. (DDTC, 2026-07-03)
